name: hcapp_getKennelSocialLinks
description: A kennel's social and chat links (E12.F4.S4, 2026-10-14) as the caller may see them, fetched when the app's kennel page (or the signed-in web's kennel page) opens — never synced. The kennels sync reaches every phone and members-only entries are chat-group invite links, so they are handed out here only to the kennel's members (MembershipExpirationDate in the future) and admins (AppAccessFlags & 0x40000081); everyone else gets the public entries. The visibility rule is HC6.KennelSocialLinksVisible, shared with publicWeb_getLandingPageData. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 155, @param NULL — a standard token); the browser calls it as a device (E9.F7). Idempotency: read-only — reads the kennel and the caller's membership.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Standard device token for hcapp_getKennelSocialLinks (paramString = device secret).

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel, by its public id (the web). Wins when both ids are sent.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel, by its internal id (the app, whose synced kennels carry it).

rowsets.description: On auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): the error detail alone, no envelope. Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown (THROW).

rowsets.name: KennelSocialLinks
rowsets.description: Exactly one row. An unknown, deleted or removed kennel, or one with no links, gives socialLinksJson NULL.

columns.name: socialLinksJson
columns.description: JSON array of {platform, url, handle, qrImageUrl, label, audience} in display order, filtered to what the caller may see; NULL when nothing is visible.

columns.name: includesMembers
columns.description: 1 = the caller is a member or admin and the members-only entries are included; 0 = public entries only.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
